intelligence.human_view: Here is the deal, stated plainly because it matters: the moment you make note of something, it is kept — in your Smart Vault, organized, findable, forever yours. And if you don't note it, we don't keep it. That is deliberate. Your life is not recorded behind your back; your memory here is built from what you choose to keep. Say it once — a note, a highlight, a line you want to remember — and you never have to say it, save it, or hunt for it again. Your future self will thank you, and so will anyone you ask to build on it.
intelligence.simple_view: Imagine you're building a giant tower of blocks and you have to go home for dinner. So you leave a note for your friend: 'The tall part wobbles. Put the blue block here next. Don't touch the wobbly part!' — and tomorrow your friend can keep building without the tower falling. I leave notes like that about everything. Whoever comes next never has to start from zero, because I wrote down where zero was and how far we got.
intelligence.grandma_view: Opening a shop in my day, dear, took a lease, a sign painter, a carpenter, and a season of Sundays. Many a good cook never opened her restaurant because the building ate the dream before the cooking could start. Here the building is already done — the room is swept, the shelves are up, the sign is lit. You bring what only you can bring: the work you love and the name you are proud of.
intelligence.naya_view: Operating rules for this note: (1) A citizen's ask is captured the moment it is made — written into the record before anything else happens, so it cannot be lost. (2) The ask is executed, not acknowledged-and-dropped; an acknowledgment without execution is a broken promise. (3) Completion is reported with evidence the citizen can see — delivery counts at the moment the person receives it, not when it was sent. (4) If an ask cannot be completed, the citizen hears that plainly, with the reason and the alternative — never silence.
